propositions: Code snapshot entries rebuild all blobs fresh on each cache.acquire without reusing unchanged blobs from adjacent SHA entries, incurring 4x write amplification for N successive resolutions.

The materialize populate branch uses git read-tree and git checkout-index for every resolution, identical to the pre-fix tickets behavior, with zero hardlink or delta sharing against neighbouring entries.
A generic delta_tree helper exists post-bug-8386 to support donor-selection and hardlink-clone; wiring code snapshots through it mirrors the tickets fix with minimal surface change.

Attestation basis for signed verdicts requires that storage sharing not weaken the guarantee that <store>/<sha> faithfully represents the tree at sha, and that LFS pointers and submodule caveat detection remain unaffected by the delta path.
